glosses: the act or result of diverging (to tend into different directions)
diversion (tactic used to draw attention away from the real threat or action)

examples.text: Gosto de ir ao parque de diversões.
examples.en: I like going to the amusement park.

examples.text: Aqui é onde a diversão começa.
examples.en: This is where the fun begins.

examples.text: Ontem encontrei meu professor no parque de diversões.
examples.en: Yesterday, I ran into my teacher at the amusement park.
